title: Semi Detached Villa for sale in Nueva Andalucia, Marbella
summary:
This stunning newly-built modern semi-detached villa, is part of an exclusive project comprising 11 prestigious villas. Nestled within a gated community in Nueva Andalucia, this superb property showcases a unique and captivating approach to modern architecture, featuring sleek lines and a geometric facade that commands attention. The neutral-toned natural materials used for

the exterior add a touch of elegance. The property offers multiple covered terraces, ideal for outdoor alfresco dining and relaxation, allowing residents to enjoy the outdoors even during brief rain showers. A private pool adds to the allure, while the bespoke solarium provides panoramic views of Nueva Andalucia, La Concha, the Mediterranean Sea and Gibraltar. With its south/western orientation, the villa is bathed in sunlight throughout the day, allowing for breathtaking sunsets. Spanning across 4 floors, this exceptional property boasts 4 bedrooms, each with its own en-suite bathroom. The state-of-the-art kitchen is fully equipped with the latest appliances, and underfloor heating adds a touch of comfort. The villa also includes a private garage with space for up to 2 cars. Celeste 11 enjoys a privileged location in Nueva Andalucia, offering convenient access to a wide range of amenities and essential services. With

its impressive architecture, privacy, and convenient surroundings, this stunning  property represents the epitome of luxury living in Marbella.
